title: Sentiment classification stability
description: A managed classifier feels like a fixed function, so teams wire it straight into routing rules and never test it again. It is not fixed: AWS updates the model underneath, and regional endpoints do not always agree. This contract pins the labels a routing rule depends on, including the genuinely hard mixed-signal case that decides whether an angry customer reaches a human.

cases.input: This is the third time this week the app has lost my work. I am done. Cancel my subscription.
The new export feature saved my team an entire afternoon. Genuinely excellent work.
The invoice for March was issued on the 3rd and covers seats 1 through 40.
Support was lovely and fixed it fast, but this is the fourth outage this month and we are evaluating alternatives.
